died.name: Augustus
died.last_words: Have I played the part well? Then applaud, as I exit.

died.name: Thomas Bilney
died.cause: While he awaited burning for heresy, the friars and people present argued over who was responsible for Bilney's death; the friars threatened to withhold alms from the people if they were blamed
died.last_words: I pray you, good people, be not the worse to these men on my account, as though they were the authors of my death.
